title: Amphibians: name the family
intro: Name the taxonomic family of each animal (amphibians).

questions.prompt: To which family does the Common Midwife Toad (Alytes obstetricans) belong?
questions.explain: The Common Midwife Toad (Alytes obstetricans) belongs to the family painted frogs, order Anura.

questions.prompt: To which family does the Mexican burrowing toad (Rhinophrynus dorsalis) belong?
questions.explain: The Mexican burrowing toad (Rhinophrynus dorsalis) belongs to the family Rhinophrynidae, order Anura.

questions.prompt: To which family does the red-eyed tree frog (Agalychnis callidryas) belong?
questions.explain: The red-eyed tree frog (Agalychnis callidryas) belongs to the family Hylidae, order Anura.

questions.prompt: To which family does the Darwin's frog (Rhinoderma darwinii) belong?
questions.explain: The Darwin's frog (Rhinoderma darwinii) belongs to the family Rhinodermatidae, order Anura.

questions.prompt: To which family does the Purple Frog (Nasikabatrachus sahyadrensis) belong?
questions.explain: The Purple Frog (Nasikabatrachus sahyadrensis) belongs to the family Nasikabatrachidae, order Anura.

questions.prompt: To which family does the hellbender (Cryptobranchus alleganiensis) belong?
questions.explain: The hellbender (Cryptobranchus alleganiensis) belongs to the family Cryptobranchidae, order Caudata.

questions.prompt: To which family does the Red-eyed Green Treefrog (Litoria chloris) belong?
questions.explain: The Red-eyed Green Treefrog (Litoria chloris) belongs to the family Pelodryadidae, order Anura.

questions.prompt: To which family does the Asian common toad (Duttaphrynus melanostictus) belong?
questions.explain: The Asian common toad (Duttaphrynus melanostictus) belongs to the family Bufonidae, order Anura.

questions.prompt: To which family does the olm (Proteus anguinus) belong?
questions.explain: The olm (Proteus anguinus) belongs to the family mudpuppy, order Urodela.

questions.prompt: To which family does the Hairy Frog (Trichobatrachus robustus) belong?
questions.explain: The Hairy Frog (Trichobatrachus robustus) belongs to the family Arthroleptidae, order Anura.
